title: Whole Bell Cup Machine and Hand Tool Preparation Table
description: One static leatherworking equipment-preparation table, one scene zero new independent models. One whole open worktable supports the complete open bell-cup and feed-roller bench machine at left, rigidly turned ninety degrees so its original empty cup/approach region faces the front. A whole fixed-open radial-turret hand punch rests separately at right and an entire cutaway bobbin-grip sewing awl lies across the forward-right tabletop. All complete ground soles remain on the original finite flat top with visible empty strips between devices. This is a compact machine-and-hand-tool preparation surface, not the old pedestal horn-machine with a separate shoe-last floor stand and stretcher table, or cloth-pattern cutting table. Every original unit-scale mesh buffer, normal, internal hierarchy and PBR dictionary is preserved; only whole rigid placements and one finite floor are new. No leather, shoes, workpieces, extracted components or new standalone furniture. The small awl and turret details remain subordinate at whole-scene scale. Static artistic arrangement only: no skiving, stitching, punching, sharp edge, machine motion, electrical operation, workflow correctness, tool compatibility, human fit, rated loading or workplace safety claim. Rigging animation interaction not made.
